text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The Beautification Committee's off-campus cleanup...
Hehe, so many child volunteers showed up!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—There are Umamusume among them too.
I'd like to call them by nicknames to help ease their nerves, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For this name, maybe the first three letters...
No, does the end sound more natural?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe taking a letter from the middle,
like with my "Me-chan"...
Wait, how would that... even work...?
The night wore on as I pondered what names to give the children...
